scripts.lint:readiness: eslint app/api/pos/checkout/route.ts 'app/(operator)/pos' lib/pos lib/quick-pos tests/pos tests/quick-pos tests/middleware.test.ts tests/auth
scripts.lint:compliance: eslint app components lib middleware.ts instrumentation-client.ts --quiet || (echo '❌ Compliance violations detected' && exit 1)
scripts.compliance:secrets: git ls-files | grep -E '^\.env\.' | grep -v '^\.env\.example' && echo '❌ Environment files found in git - secrets may be exposed' && exit 1 || echo '✅ No environment files tracked in git'
scripts.compliance:lockfiles: if [ $(git ls-files | grep -E 'package-lock\.json|yarn\.lock' | wc -l) -gt 1 ]; then echo '❌ Multiple package manager lockfiles found' && exit 1; else echo '✅ Single package manager enforced'; fi
scripts.compliance:imports: eslint . --max-warnings=0 || (echo '❌ Banned vendor imports detected' && exit 1)
scripts.compliance:full: npm run compliance:secrets && npm run compliance:lockfiles && npm run compliance:imports && npm run verify:tarballs && npm run verify:lock && echo '✅ All compliance checks passed'
scripts.test:e2e:required: prisma generate && VISUAL_FIXTURES=true playwright test tests/e2e/auth-routing.spec.ts tests/e2e/login-surfaces.spec.ts --workers=1 && BYPASS_AUTH_FOR_TESTING=true BYPASS_AUTH_USER_ID=user_required_ux BYPASS_AUTH_ORG_ID=org_required_ux playwright test tests/e2e/help-center-smoke.spec.ts tests/e2e/ux-smoke.spec.ts --workers=1
scripts.test:e2e:quick-pos-smoke: BYPASS_AUTH_FOR_TESTING=true BYPASS_AUTH_USER_ID=user_required_pos BYPASS_AUTH_ORG_ID=org_required_pos playwright test tests/e2e/quick-pos-required.spec.ts --project=chromium --workers=1
scripts.test:e2e:a11y: PLAYWRIGHT_APP_PORT=3100 PW_NEXT_WEBPACK=1 PW_SKIP_GLOBAL_SETUP=1 playwright test tests/e2e/a11y.spec.ts --workers=1
scripts.test:e2e:a11y:required: PLAYWRIGHT_APP_PORT=3100 PW_NEXT_WEBPACK=1 PW_SKIP_GLOBAL_SETUP=1 BYPASS_AUTH_FOR_TESTING=false A11Y_TARGET=public playwright test tests/e2e/a11y.spec.ts --workers=1 && PLAYWRIGHT_APP_PORT=3100 PW_NEXT_WEBPACK=1 PW_SKIP_GLOBAL_SETUP=1 BYPASS_AUTH_FOR_TESTING=true BYPASS_AUTH_USER_ID=user_required_a11y BYPASS_AUTH_ORG_ID=org_required_a11y A11Y_TARGET=protected playwright test tests/e2e/a11y.spec.ts --workers=1
scripts.test:e2e:visual:required: PW_NEXT_WEBPACK=1 VISUAL_TARGET=public VISUAL_FIXTURES=true BYPASS_AUTH_FOR_TESTING=false playwright test tests/e2e/visual-regression.spec.ts --project=chromium --workers=1 && PW_NEXT_WEBPACK=1 VISUAL_TARGET=protected VISUAL_FIXTURES=true BYPASS_AUTH_FOR_TESTING=true BYPASS_AUTH_USER_ID=user_required_visual BYPASS_AUTH_ORG_ID=org_required_visual playwright test tests/e2e/visual-regression.spec.ts --project=chromium --workers=1
scripts.test:integration: VITEST_INCLUDE_INTEGRATION=true vitest run tests/integration tests/auth tests/middleware.test.ts
scripts.test:required:auth-data: vitest run tests/middleware.test.ts tests/auth tests/pos tests/quick-pos
